title: Waggle Route
effect: Move one Support to a neighbouring district with two free spots. Then add a second Support of the same party there.

title: Common Cause
effect: Choose a district with two free spots and Support of another party voting the same way as Honeycomb on that region’s pending policy. Add one Support each of Honeycomb and that party there.

title: Every Bee Counts
effect: Choose a party. Wherever it has exactly one Support and there is space, add a second.

title: Dig In
effect: Move one Support to a neighbouring district with space. Then add one Support of the same party to the district it left, if there is space.

title: Stonewall
effect: Choose a party. In a district containing its Support or a neighbouring district, remove two Support belonging to a single rival party.

title: Institutional Memory
effect: Choose a district and either For or Against its region’s pending policy. Add up to one Support of each party voting that way to free spots in that district.

title: Spin
effect: Choose a party. In a district containing its Support or a neighbouring district, replace one rival Support with Support of your chosen party.

title: Whisper Network
effect: Choose a party. Swap one of its Support with one rival Support in a neighbouring district.

title: Shell Firm
effect: Choose a party. Move its Firm marker and entire Operation pile to another party without a Firm marker. End your Lobby action.

title: Canal Network
effect: Move any number of one party’s Support from one district to another with enough space. Every district along the route, except the destination, must contain that party’s Support.

title: Public Works
effect: Choose a district containing a party’s Support. Add one Support of that party there and one in a neighbouring district. Both districts must have space.

title: Mass Transit
effect: Choose a chain of two to five neighbouring districts with space at one end. Move one Support from each other district one step towards that end, starting nearest the space.

title: Scatter the Flock
effect: Add one Support to a district where that party already has Support and there is space. Then spread as many of that party’s Support as possible into neighbouring districts with space, one per district. Move at least one.

title: Joint Campaign
effect: Choose a district and either For or Against its region’s pending policy. Bring in one to three Support from neighbouring districts, belonging to parties voting that way. You need space for them.

title: Empty Every Nest
effect: Choose a party. From as many districts as possible where it has at least two Support, move one to a different district where it has none and there is space. Use each destination only once.

title: Quiet Hours
effect: Add one Support to a district where that party already has Support and there is space. Then add one Support of the same party to a district containing no Support.

title: Midnight Leak
effect: Choose a party. Remove one rival Support in or next to a district containing its Support. If possible, remove a second Support of that rival party from a district next to the first target.

title: Midnight Session
effect: Reopen a closed party by placing one of your returned Firm markers there. Its Operation pile starts empty.
